name_input: RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED; Rajoo Engineers Ltd.- Wonderpack Division; RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED
revenue_source: Screener.in company page (BSE 522257) standalone P&L, Mar 2025 and Mar 2026, derived from audited annual results filed with exchanges
note: Legal entity confirmed: Rajoo Engineers Limited, incorporated 1986, promoted by C.N. Doshi and R.N. Doshi; registered office Rajoo Avenue, Survey No. 210, Plot No. 1, Industrial Area, Veraval (Shapar), Dist-Rajkot 360024, Gujarat (company website). Listed on BSE (522257) and NSE (RAJOOENG), so MCA status is active/listed. CIN not verified: zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403 and the search tool was unavailable, so CIN is null rather than guessed. PAN and GSTIN not retrieved from any public profile (no accessible source), therefore null; GST status unknown. 'Wonderpack Division' appears to be a division/unit of the same legal entity, not a separate company. State claimed in input was empty; registered state is Gujarat. Revenue figures are standalone (not consolidated) from Screener.in's compilation of audited filings; FY26 = year ended March 2026. Role: manufacturer of plastic extrusion machinery (blown film lines, sheet lines, thermoformers) at its Rajkot works. Declared HS codes 847720/847790 (extruders and parts) and 842240 (packing machinery) are consistent with the product range; 392310 (plastic boxes) is not a manufactured line and would be a trading/incidental code, but per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground.
